verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a DevOps platform, but the pack documents no first-party data or project export feature, and nothing about open export formats. The REST API and Git usage are building blocks a user could script against, not an export capability. The importer evidence covers moving data into GitLab, not leaving it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
